title: NPD Manager
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced
**NPD Manager**
to drive innovation and product development in the food and nutrition segment. The role involves managing the end-to-end New Product Development (NPD) lifecycle, from concept development and formulation to commercialization and product launch, with a focus on nutrition, taste, quality, food safety, and market demand.

The candidate will lead the development of products such as
**protein bars, protein powders, nutritional spreads, breakfast cereals, and other innovative food and nutrition products**
, ensuring regulatory compliance and commercial viability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and launch innovative food and nutrition products, including
  **protein bars, protein powders, nutritional spreads, breakfast cereals, and other functional food products**
  .
* Manage the complete NPD lifecycle, from ideation and formulation to trials, scale-up, commercialization, and market launch.
* Ensure products meet nutritional requirements, taste expectations, quality standards, and consumer preferences.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations, food safety standards, and product labelling requirements.
* Identify and evaluate new ingredients, functional ingredients, suppliers, and packaging materials.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, consumer trials, and sensory evaluations to improve product formulations.
* Collaborate with R&D, production, quality assurance, procurement, and marketing teams to ensure successful product launches.
* Optimize product formulations and manufacturing costs while maintaining product quality and nutritional value.
* Oversee product trials, shelf-life studies, stability testing, and manufacturing scale-up.
* Monitor project timelines, budgets, product performance, and commercialization milestones.
* Keep up to date with emerging trends in kids’ nutrition, functional foods, protein-based products, and health-focused FMCG categories.

title: Founders Office
description:
About SurelyPlaced

SurelyPlaced helps international candidates in the US (OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, H-1B and H-4 EAD) land the jobs they're qualified for. We run their entire job search end to end: ATS-optimized resumes, high-volume targeted applications, and interview preparation. We're growing fast and expanding into new global markets.

About the Role

The Founder's Office is where our most important problems land first. You'll work directly with the founders on strategy, special projects and execution across sales, marketing, operations and new markets. This role is for someone who wants founder-level exposure early in their career, and who would rather own outcomes than tasks.

Compensation

• ₹9 LPA fixed (₹75,000/month)

• Up to ₹3 LPA performance-based variable (up to ₹25,000/month)

• Total CTC: up to ₹12 LPA

Work Setup

• Full-time, hybrid

• Office: Vaishnodevi Circle, Gandhinagar

What You'll Do

• Drive high-priority projects for the founders from idea to execution

• Support new market launches with research, planning and coordination

• Build and track business dashboards and MIS across sales, marketing and operations

• Find bottlenecks in our processes and fix them, with documentation and SOPs

• Coordinate across sales, marketing, delivery and hiring teams to keep priorities moving

• Prepare decks, briefs and analyses that help the founders make decisions faster

• Use AI tools and automation to make the team faster and more efficient

• Step in wherever the business needs you most that week

What We're Looking For

• 1–4 years of experience in a startup, consulting, strategy, operations or a founder's office role (exceptional freshers welcome)

• High ownership: you treat problems like they're your own

• Structured thinker who brings clarity to ambiguous, fast-moving situations

• Strong written and verbal communication in English

• Comfortable with data: strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, able to turn numbers into decisions

• Bias for action: you ship, learn and iterate quickly

• Trustworthy with confidential, founder-level information

Good to Have

• MBA or a degree from a strong business, engineering or economics program

• Experience in EdTech, staffing, career services or a high-growth startup

• Hands-on with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automation platforms such as n8n/Zapier)

• Exposure to sales operations, growth marketing or international markets

Why Join Us

• Work directly with the founders and see how a company is built from the inside

• Ownership of real projects from week one

• Fast-track growth into leadership roles as the company scales

• Hybrid flexibility with a collaborative office in Gandhinagar

How to Apply

Apply directly through LinkedIn, or email your resume to hr@surelyplaced.com with the subject line "Founder's Office – [Your Name]". Bonus: include 3–4 lines on a project you fully owned and what it achieved.

**Designation: Manager/ Sr. Manager- Product Innovation & Fabric Expert**
**Location: Gandhinagar**
**About The Role**
To lead product innovation and fabric development initiatives for the Covers category by improving product aesthetics, functionality, durability, and customer experience through advanced fabric research, innovative stitching techniques, accessories development, and product engineering. The role will be responsible for repositioning the entire Covers portfolio by identifying best-in-class fabrics, optimizing product construction, and introducing innovative design features that enhance perceived value while maintaining cost competitiveness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Design & Aesthetic Enhancement
* Review existing Covers portfolio and benchmark against global competitors.
* Develop innovative stitching patterns and construction methods to improve product appearance.
* Improve product fit, shape retention, and premium look.
* Introduce design elements that enhance customer perception and usability.
* Standardize product finishing specifications across categories.
* Improve packaging and presentation of finished products.
* Accessories & Trim Innovation
* Develop and evaluate accessories such as:
* Buckles
* Straps
* Drawcords
* Elastic systems
* Velcro closures
* Air vents
* Handles
* Reinforcement patches
* Branding elements
* Identify opportunities to improve functionality and aesthetics through trims and hardware.
* Fabric Research & Development
* Lead fabric innovation programs for all cover categories.
* Evaluate lighter-weight fabrics without compromising durability.
* Develop category-wise fabric strategy based on:
* Weather resistance
* UV resistance
* Water repellency
* Breathability
* Strength
* Cost
* Customer expectations
* Benchmark global fabric suppliers and technologies.
* Develop alternative fabric sourcing strategies to reduce cost and improve performance.
* Work with suppliers on new coating and finishing technologies.
* Product Engineering & Testing
* Define performance standards for each category.
* Conduct testing for:
* UV resistance
* Waterproofness
* Tear strength
* Abrasion resistance
* Color fastness
* Weathering performance
* Establish product validation protocols before commercialization.
* Create technical specifications and BOM standards.
* Competitive Benchmarking
* Benchmark leading brands in:
* Outdoor covers
* Furniture covers
* Grill covers
* Equipment covers
* Automotive covers
* Identify innovation trends and customer pain points.
* Recommend product upgrades based on market intelligence.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with:
* Design Team
* Sourcing Team
* Manufacturing Team
* Quality Team
* Product Management Team
* Support pilot runs and commercialization of new products.
* Drive innovation projects from concept to production launch.

**Key Deliverables (First 12 Months)**
**Product Enhancement**

* Complete review of entire Covers portfolio.
* Develop category-wise premium product positioning strategy.
* Launch improved construction standards for all key categories.

**Fabric Development**
Identify and validate lighter-weight fabric alternatives.
  
  
Develop fabric matrix for each cover category.
  
  
Deliver minimum 3–5 new fabric innovations.
  
  
**Innovation Pipeline**
Launch minimum 10 product improvement initiatives.
  
  
Reduce product weight while maintaining performance standards.
  
  
Improve customer satisfaction related to fit, appearance, and functionality.
  
  
**Cost & Value Improvement**
Improve value perception without increasing product cost significantly.
  
  
Develop premium and value-engineered product tiers.
  
  
**Key Requirements**
**Education**

* B.Tech / B.E. Textile Technology
* Technical Textiles
* Apparel Technology
* Product Engineering

**Experience**

* 10–15+ years experience in:
* Technical textiles
* Outdoor products
* Protective covers
* Furniture covers
* Automotive covers
* Home furnishing products
* Product development

**Technical Skills**

* Fabric development and sourcing
* Sewing engineering
* Pattern development
* Technical textiles
* Product testing
* Product innovation
* Vendor development
* Cost engineering

**Desired Industry Background**
**Preferred From**

* Outdoor furniture cover manufacturers
* Automotive cover manufacturers
* Technical textile companies
* Home furnishing manufacturers
* Global brands specializing in outdoor protection products
